heading: Support of Federal prisoners in non-Federal institutions

tree.heading: In general
tree.text: The Attorney General may make payments to States and units of local government for the purposes authorized in section 4013 of title 18.

tree.heading: Authorization of appropriations
tree.text: Notwithstanding any other provision of this part other than section 12108(a)(2) of this title, there are authorized to be appropriated from amounts authorized under section 12108 of this title for each of fiscal years 1996 through 2000 such sums as may be necessary to carry out this section.

notes.heading: Codification
notes.text: Section was formerly classified to section 13711 of Title 42, The Public Health and Welfare, prior to editorial reclassification and renumbering as this section.
